# Senate results page — implementation plan

Spec: `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-10-senate-results-design.md` (authoritative; §3 is the data contract). Research: `docs/analysis/senate-research.md`. Branch `senate/results`. Plain JS ESM, no TypeScript, UI copy Czech, `TZ=UTC vitest run`.

**Rules for every task:** touch only the files named; do not edit anything under `cloudflare/`, `src/`, `public/`, `api/`; do not commit (the orchestrator commits after review); do not call `wrangler deploy`; no network calls in tests (fixtures only); keep code minimal — no speculative abstractions. Scratch: real ČSÚ files already downloaded at `$SCRATCH/feeds/` (`odata_vysledky.xml` = frozen 2026, `h24/odata_vysledky.xml` = 2024 final both rounds, `reg/serk.json`, `cis/cpp.json`, `cis/cns.json`, `vysledky_celk.xml`, `navig_obvody.json`) where `SCRATCH=/tmp/claude-1000/-home-vislousv-SyncThing-70-AI-pirati-elec-tracker--claude-worktrees-interesting-einstein-b5e656/f0747433-5c3b-4a51-85cf-03c61970bbf3/scratchpad`. Do not re-download them.

## Layout
```
cloudflare-senat/
  package.json  wrangler.jsonc  README.md
  fixtures/        se2026-frozen.xml  se2024-final.xml  (+ small hand-made XMLs)
  src/ xml.js  normalize.js  derive.js  validate.js  refresh.js  edge.js  time.js  manifest.js  worker.js
       *.test.js
scripts/senat-build-manifest.mjs
senat/                (Vite root)  index.html  vite.config.js  src/{main.jsx,App.jsx,schedule.js,freshness.js,format.js,*.test.js,styles.css}  public/{humans.txt,kontakt.txt,.well-known/security.txt}
```
Root edits (additive only): `vitest.config.js` `include` += `'cloudflare-senat/**/*.test.js'`, `'senat/**/*.test.js'`; `package.json` scripts += `"build:senat": "vite build --config senat/vite.config.js"`, and lint must cover the new dirs (check `eslint.config.js` globs; extend only if needed).

## Task 1 — fixtures, manifest, XML parser, normaliser  (Sonnet)
1. Copy `se2026-frozen.xml`, `se2024-final.xml` into `cloudflare-senat/fixtures/` (utf-8).
2. `scripts/senat-build-manifest.mjs`: reads `serk.json` (path arg), `cpp.json`, `cns.json`, plus the owner list below, writes `cloudflare-senat/src/manifest.js` exporting `CANDIDATES` (object keyed `"<obvod>:<no>"` → `{first,last,pre,post,age,job,residence,party,partyCode,member}`; `last` from registry `PRIJMENI`, `pre` = `TITULPRED`, `party` = name of `NSTRANA` from `cns.json` (`NAZEV_STRN`), `member` = name of `PSTRANA` from `cpp.json` (`NAZEV_STRP`), missing optional fields → `null`), `PIRATE_BACKED` = `[{obvod,no,relation}]`, `OBVODY` = `{n: name}` from `navig_obvody.json`, header comment with source files + their SHA-256 + generation date. Owner list (obvod: surname): 30 Šípová, 18 Luftová, 75 Szyja (relation `ticket`, must have `NSTRANA === 720`, else the script exits non-zero); endorsed: 21 Šarapatka, 24 Smoljak, 27 Padevět, 3 Plevný, 6 Hluštíková, 33 Štross, 45 Dvořák, 48 Grulich, 51 Černý, 54 Třetina, 57 Grolich, 60 Papoušek, 66 Kohajda, 69 Pešatová, 72 Šimetka. Resolve by `OBVOD` + surname containment (case-insensitive); each must match **exactly one** registry row or the script fails. Expected: Šípová → `30:2`, Luftová → `18:5`, Szyja → `75:2`, Šarapatka `21:2`, Smoljak `24:2`, Padevět `27:7`, Plevný `3:1`, Hluštíková `6:4`, Štross `33:5`, Dvořák `45:7`, Grulich `48:2`, Černý `51:4`, Třetina `54:2`, Grolich `57:2`, Papoušek `60:1`, Kohajda `66:1`, Pešatová `69:6`, Šimetka `72:3`. Run it and commit the generated file.
3. `src/xml.js`: `parseResultsXml(text)` → `{ generated, obvody:[{n,name,candidates:[{no,first,last,pre,post,votes1,pct1,st1,votes2,pct2,st2}],ucast:{1:{…},2:{…}}}], country:{1,2} }` — a small attribute-only parser (regex over `<OBVOD…>…</OBVOD>`, `<KANDIDAT …/>`, `<UCAST …/>`, `<CELKEM>`), decoding `&amp; &lt; &gt; &quot; &apos; &#N; &#xH;`; numbers as numbers; absent optional attributes → `null`; **throws** `Error` with a clear message on: missing `VYSLEDKY` root, `<CHYBA>`, zero `OBVOD`, an `OBVOD` without candidates/`UCAST`, non-numeric numeric attributes. Unknown attributes are ignored. No DOM, no deps.
4. `src/time.js`: `parsePragueTime('2026-10-10T16:05:12')` → epoch ms using Europe/Prague DST (CEST UTC+2 from last Sunday of March 01:00 UTC to last Sunday of October 01:00 UTC, else UTC+1); returns `null` for invalid input. Tests: 2026-10-10 → +02:00; 2026-10-25T01:59:59 → +02:00; 2026-10-25T03:00:00 → +01:00 (note the ambiguous hour 02:00–02:59 resolves to the first occurrence, +02:00); 2026-12-01 → +01:00; invalid → null.
5. `src/normalize.js`: `normalize(parsed, {manifest, now?})` → the spec §3 snapshot **without** `state/status/summary` (those come from `derive.js`; leave `normalize` to produce `obvody[].candidates[]` with `pirate`, `party`, `member`, `age`, `job`, `residence`, `warnings`). Pirate attribution per spec §5 incl. surname verification (diacritics-insensitive).
Tests (`xml.test.js`, `normalize.test.js`, `time.test.js`, `manifest.test.js`) on the real fixtures: frozen 2026 → 27 obvody, 154 candidates, round 1, all zero, all 18 Pirate candidates found with correct relation and **no** warnings; 2024 final → round 2, obvod 5 has `st1` `2.KOLO` ×2, `votes2` 6097/6862, `ZVOLEN_2KOLO` `ZVOLEN` for no 5; obvod 17 has no round 2; hand-made XMLs: `&amp;` entity, missing attribute, `CHYBA`, empty body, garbage. Manifest test: 18 entries, 3 tickets all `partyCode 720`, all manifest keys exist in the frozen XML with matching surname.

## Task 2 — derivation  (Sonnet; independent of Task 3–5 once Task 1 types exist)
`src/derive.js`: `derive(normalized)` → adds per-obvod `state`, `decidedRound`, per-candidate `rank`, `status`, `official`, `majority`, `hasPirate`, and the `summary` block exactly per spec §3.1. Pure. Tests with small synthetic snapshots built by a helper `mk()` in the test: waiting → counting → counted → official `ZVOLEN` r1 (absolute majority) → `2.KOLO` pair → runoff-counting by `votes2` → `ZVOLEN` r2; tie for first (two `leading`), tie for second, ≥3 advancing, `NEZVOLEN_SHODA_HLASU`, an obvod without Pirates, summary counts incl. the Pirate tally, `majority` only when `!official`. Plus real-fixture tests: frozen 2026 → `decided 0, waiting 27`, Pirates `waiting 18`; 2024 final → obvod 17 `elected` r1, obvod 5 `elected` r2, `summary.decided` = 27, no candidate with `official:false`.

## Task 3 — validator + refresher  (Sonnet)
`src/validate.js` per spec §4: `validateCandidate(candidate, good, ctx)` → `{outcome, reason?}` and `snapshotHash`. `src/refresh.js`: **copy `cloudflare/refresh.js` (read-only) into this file and adapt**: remove `kind`/overview/merge/`complete`/`firstClass`/`phaseOf` council coupling; `createRefresher({now, random, storage, feed, base, log, pollsClose, waitUntil})`; `feed.build({signal, validators})` returns `{notModified:true}` or `{snapshot, validators:{etag,lastModified}, fetchId}`; store `validators` in `meta`; on `notModified` advance `refreshedAt/nextRefreshAt` only (no persist of the snapshot body, persist `meta`); phases `waiting|counting|final` per spec §2 (`phaseOfSnapshot(snapshot, nowMs)` exported; `final` = `summary.decided === summary.obvody`); `POLLS_CLOSE = Date.parse('2026-10-10T14:00:00+02:00')` as default, injectable. Keep: single-flight, rehydrate `base`/`schema` check, persisted `{snapshot, meta}` in one `put`, size guard, backoff, `older`, quarantine (3 distinct fetches over ≥ 2 min), invalidate-on-reject (`feed.invalidate()` clears stored validators). `src/edge.js`: copy of `cloudflare/edge.js` (`edgeTtl`, `cacheControlFor`, `markStale`, `lastResortRequest`, `withTimeout`, `LAST_RESORT_TTL`) with the phase caps of spec §2. Also `src/feed.js`: `createSenatFeed({baseUrl, fetchImpl, userAgent, manifest})` → `{build, invalidate}` doing the conditional GET (headers `If-None-Match`/`If-Modified-Since` from stored validators, `Accept: application/xml`, 8 s per-request timeout via `AbortSignal`), `parseResultsXml → normalize → derive`; non-200/304 or an XML error → throws.
Tests (port the relevant cases from `cloudflare/refresh.test.js`, do not copy tests for removed features): 304 path; zone-less `generated` under TZ=UTC; concurrent `get()` ×2000 → 1 upstream call; simulated 5-minute counting run (ČSÚ publishes each 60 s, 50 `get()`/s → upstream calls within [5, 15]); failure/timeout/empty body/`CHYBA` keep the last-good and serve `stale:true`; regression reject + quarantine accept after 3 fetches/2 min; official-flag-disappears reject; `older` (no backoff, not stale); pre-`POLLS_CLOSE` baseline skip (test data then reset to zero must be accepted immediately); rehydrate with wrong `base`/`schema` discarded; phase scheduling (`waiting` 60 s, `counting` clamp, junk `generated`, `final` 10 min); size guard.

## Task 4 — Worker + config  (Sonnet)
`src/worker.js`: `export class SenatFeed extends DurableObject` (`run()` → `{status, body, cacheControl, stale, phase}`; builds the refresher once; storage adapter over `ctx.storage`; env `CSU_BASE` default `https://volby.gov.cz/appdata/senat/20261009`; `base` = that value), `export default { fetch, scheduled }`: `/api/senat` (GET/HEAD) → Cache API key `new Request(origin + '/api/senat')`, HIT/MISS, DO call under 13 s timeout, last-resort copy (key `/__lastresort/api/senat`, 1200 s), 503 JSON on total failure, `x-server-now`, `x-cache` HIT/MISS, `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` not set; `scheduled` calls the DO (15 s timeout, errors logged); `/healthz` → `ok` plain text (no DO); any other path → `env.ASSETS.fetch(request)`, and unknown asset paths 404 (SPA has a single route `/`). Log lines as JSON (`event`, `level`, …). `wrangler.jsonc`, `package.json` (`wrangler ^4.147.0`, scripts `build` = `npm --prefix .. run build:senat`, `dev`, `deploy:staging`), `README.md` (runbook in English+Czech key lines: deploy order, rollback, kill switch, checks, **maintainer contact**). `npx wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir /tmp/x` must succeed in `cloudflare-senat/` for both default and `--env staging` (dry-run only!). Verify with `wrangler dev --local` (port 8799) against the **real frozen feed**: `curl -i /api/senat` twice → `x-cache` MISS then HIT, body `v:1`, 27 obvody, 18 `pirate` candidates; `curl /healthz`; second `build` returns 304 path (check the log). Record the transcript in the task report.

## Task 6 — verification and staging  (orchestrator)
Run `npm test && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run build:senat`; Opus diff review; one Codex pass over the whole diff; staging deploy from `cloudflare-senat/` (`wrangler deployments list` first, record ids; `--env staging`); staging checks (two consecutive HIT/MISS, `x-server-now`, 503 behaviour not forced); after ~15:00 compare real counted data with the public app/`vysledky.xml`; tighten soft checks; report to the owner. Production + `senat.dg12.cz` custom domain **only on the owner's explicit confirmation**.

## Review gates
Opus adversarial review of spec+plan → fixes → one Codex pass on spec+plan (`codex-review.sh --scope plan`, `CODEX_REVIEW_MODEL=gpt-5.6-sol`) → fixes → Tasks (Sonnet implementer, then Opus review per task, fixes) → one Codex pass over the whole diff.
